slides.title: Stuck in your head? *Move first.*
slides.sub: What an NIH lecture on exercise and the brain reported.

slides.title: Focus after moving
slides.body: In one study Dr. Wendy Suzuki (NYU) described at NIH, people who rode an exercise bike for an hour improved their attention.

slides.title: Mood followed fitness
slides.body: In another, people biked three times a week for 12 weeks. Their moods improved as their heart fitness improved.

slides.title: Not a prescription
slides.body: Suzuki said we don't yet know the best amount of exercise. These are findings, not a promise.

slides.title: Walk before you decide.
slides.body: Next time a decision keeps looping, move first. Then ask: what looks different now?
